items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: I learned a lot about reading under him. In fact, he's one of the best reading teachers I've ever had.

ctx.x: I'll see it. He fixes television, yeah. He's got in mind. There was another band I played before, before I forgot about, was Clyde Carr was teaching. Oh, you played with Clyde Carr? He was teaching at very good trumpet player. His father, the one that, now I say it's a senior, there's two Clyde, but one's a junior. Yeah, Clyde junior. Well, Clyde was teaching at Booker T for a year before I left there. He was into syncopation, Jimmy Luntz and things. And he had a little band, a rehearsal band, we played concerts…
